45 food inspections on our Chicago list cited pests in 14 days, from City of Chicago records, Oct 15 to Oct 28, 2026.

40 of the 45 were at restaurants. Tuesdays had the most (15), then Mondays (10). In the last 7 days alone, restaurant pest citations came from 7 community areas, from O'Hare to South Shore.

If you run a pest control company in Chicago, our weekly list names each place with the City's result, date and codes. Free sample: link in bio (proofnotfluff.com).
